summary.text: Ana Hernandez is a Democratic state representative and attorney who has represented Texas House District 143 since December 2005 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ana Hernandez is an attorney with the Mostyn Law Firm.
She has worked as an attorney for ConocoPhillips, as a staffer for Texas State Representative Joe E. Moreno, and as chief of staff for Texas State Representative Jessica Farrar.
She is the founder of Latinas on the Rise and sits on the board of directors of the Houston Hispanic Bar Association.
In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the State Affairs Committee and also served on the Calendars and Licensing & Administrative Procedures committees.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Frank Salazar is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
